$comment: Example drive profile. Copy to skills.local.json (gitignored) and edit. The public repo ships this file with no real names: the selection is yours. include[] = skills copied to <drive>/config/pi/skills; packages[] = third-party extensions vendored under <drive>/config/pi/packages; settings{} = extra keys merged into <drive>/config/pi/settings.json.

packages.name: example-package
packages.reason: vendored, not installed at run time: the build copies the package plus its dependency closure into <drive>/config/pi/packages/node_modules, and settings.json points at it with a drive-relative path. Spec may also be a bare 'example-pi-package' (version read from the host install). Set requiresHostSdk when the extension spawns child pi processes or otherwise imports the host packages: the build then also vendors @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, pi-agent-core, pi-ai, typebox and their dependency closure into <drive>/tools/pi.

exclude.name: example-skill-not-portable
exclude.reason: why it cannot be shipped: talks to a service on your LAN, needs a GPU box, needs a private package, or depends on a host path
